# Opensource.com

> A community hub dedicated to open source software, principles, and practical alternatives to proprietary tools across business, design, communication, and development.

Opensource.com provides educational resources, guides, and directories for developers, designers, and organizations exploring open source solutions. The site emphasizes the open source way—collaboration, transparency, and community-driven development—while offering practical comparisons and alternatives to popular commercial software.

## Key Topics

- Open source software
- Open source alternatives
- Linux
- Collaboration tools
- Free software
- Project management
- Design tools
- Team communication
- Nextcloud
- Self-hosted solutions
- Kubernetes
- Git
- Python
- Community-driven development
- Software licensing

## Getting Started with Open Source

- [Opensource.com](https://opensource.com): Homepage for Opensource.com community hub covering open source tools and software development.
- [What is open source?](https://opensource.com/resources/what-open-source): Beginner guide explaining open source definition, software licensing, and open source way principles.
- [The open source way](https://opensource.com/open-source-way): Defines open source principles: collaboration, transparency, meritocracy, and community building.
- [What is Linux?](https://opensource.com/resources/linux): Beginner guide explaining Linux operating system, distributions, and comparison with Windows/macOS.

## Resources and Directories

- [Open source resources](https://opensource.com/resources): Central resource hub for learning open source with tutorials, guides, and beginner-friendly content.
- [Projects and Applications](https://opensource.com/resources/projects-and-applications): Directory of open source projects and applications across various categories and use cases.
- [Open source organizations](https://opensource.com/resources/organizations): Directory of major open source organizations including Apache, CNCF, and Linux Foundation.

## Open Source Alternatives to Proprietary Software

- [Open source alternatives hub](https://opensource.com/alternatives): Hub for open source alternatives to proprietary software across business and productivity tools.
- [Alternatives to Slack for team chat](https://opensource.com/alternatives/slack): Guide to open source team chat applications like Mattermost and Rocket.Chat.
- [Alternatives to Trello](https://opensource.com/alternatives/trello): Comparison of open source kanban board and task management tools as Trello alternatives.
- [Alternatives to Skype](https://opensource.com/alternatives/skype): Review of open source video conferencing and remote communication tools like Jitsi Meet.
- [Alternatives to Gmail](https://opensource.com/alternatives/gmail): Exploration of open source webmail clients and email management tools like Nextcloud.
- [Alternatives to Google Photos](https://opensource.com/alternatives/google-photos): Comparison of self-hosted photo management solutions like Nextcloud and Piwigo.

## Design and Creative Tools Alternatives

- [Alternatives to Photoshop for designers](https://opensource.com/life/12/6/design-without-debt-five-tools-for-designers): Guide to free design tools including GIMP and Krita as budget-friendly Photoshop alternatives.
- [Alternatives to Dreamweaver](https://opensource.com/alternatives/dreamweaver): Review of open source HTML/CSS editors and WYSIWYG tools as Dreamweaver alternatives.
- [Alternatives to AutoCAD](https://opensource.com/alternatives/autocad): Comparison of open source CAD software alternatives to AutoDesk's proprietary AutoCAD.

## Scientific and Technical Alternatives

- [Alternatives to MATLAB](https://opensource.com/alternatives/matlab): Guide to open source scientific computing platforms including Julia for research and education.
- [Alternatives to Adobe Acrobat](https://opensource.com/alternatives/adobe-acrobat): Guide to open source PDF readers and editors as alternatives to Adobe Acrobat.

## Optional

- [Alternatives to Minecraft](https://opensource.com/alternatives/minecraft): Review of open source voxel-based games and alternatives like Minetest to Minecraft.
